purpose: A band of a settings page: an h2 with a `Hint` glyph that carries the one-sentence guidance, over the band body (usually a flush `Card` of `SettingRow` rows). Bands stack at the section gap with no rule between them. An anchored band shows a copy-link button in the gutter when the heading is hovered or focused; a collapsible band turns the heading into a disclosure that unfolds the body along the grid track.
useWhen: Every settings page and create page: a resource's Settings tab, Account Settings, a create form, a create drawer.
An Advanced band that starts closed (`collapsible`).
avoidWhen: A band whose heading carries a description line and actions → use `section-header`.
A disclosure list of several independent panels → use `accordion`.
related: setting-row` — the rows inside the band's card.
card` — the flush (`:padded="false"`) surface the rows sit on.
hint` — the guidance glyph beside the title.
section-header` — the band heading with a description and actions.
bestPractices: One sentence of guidance in `hint`; the title names the band in one or two words.
Set `anchor` on bands people link to.
Use `collapsible` only for an Advanced band whose defaults are right for most people; it starts closed.
Stack the bands inside one form column (`layout-column-form`); the first band takes no top margin.
